breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly instructs to compute the elongation using the exact axial deformation integral δ = ∫[0→L] P/(A(x)E) dx with the actual varying area A(x), without replacing A(x) with its arithmetic mean. The incorrect instruction to substitute the arithmetic-mean area and treat it as exact has been removed, matching the ground truth prompt.
